firstPlayerRule: In campaign play, the Rebels choose one of their figures to activate first. In a skirmish, the player whose army has the lower total Deployment cost chooses who starts with initiative; that player activates first.
officialTieBreak: In a skirmish with equal total Deployment costs, determine initiative randomly.
clarifications: Campaign play alternates a Rebel figure’s activation with an Imperial group’s activation.
In a skirmish, players alternate activating deployment groups. Pass initiative to the opponent at the end of the round.
